qa.overall_assessment: The corrected BA artifacts address the prior BA-QA objections well enough for dev to proceed. The revision no longer treats the long CodexBash Terminal case as the whole problem: it defines a payload-by-surface matrix, promotes markdown/rich content to first-class scope, broadens search patterns beyond CodexBash, includes affected renderer candidates for non-Terminal payloads, and makes unmeasured rows explicit QA closure blockers rather than implied passes.

prior_objection_results.prior_objection: Markdown/rich Codex content is not concretely analyzed.
evidence: BA spec Evidence states markdown/rich content was missing from the first pass and names MarkdownView, LatexRenderer, parser, heading/list/task-list/blockquote/strikethrough/entity, and inline-LaTeX coverage.
BA spec Payload-by-Surface Matrix has a Markdown/rich Codex text/final row with inline, detail, sidebar, mobile, evidence status, and affected renderer paths.
BA spec AC2 requires headings, lists, task lists, blockquotes, strikethrough, code, links, HTML/entities, and inline LaTeX in inline/detail/mobile surfaces.
Context evidence.per_payload_status includes markdown_rich_text with status not_yet_measured_critical and expected primitive coverage.
prior_objection_results.residual_note: Exact markdown renderer filenames remain candidate globs, but the assumption is explicit and dev is instructed to resolve paths before editing.

prior_objection_results.prior_objection: Evidence and acceptance cover only the long Terminal rendering case.
evidence: BA spec matrix covers markdown/rich, Terminal, patch/diff, plan/update, dynamic/MCP/resource, image/attachment, and multi-tool sequences.
Context evidence.per_payload_status separates measured broken Terminal from source-localized risk and not-yet-measured non-Terminal classes.
AC1 requires every matrix row to have live pass evidence or intentionally-hidden rationale, and blocks closure on unmeasured rows.
AC4 covers non-Terminal tools and fallback separately from AC3 Terminal/detail.
prior_objection_results.residual_note: The artifacts intentionally do not claim product evidence for unmeasured non-Terminal rows; this is correct for BA analysis validation because closure is blocked until QA captures live evidence.

prior_objection_results.prior_objection: Scope is CodexBash-only or centered on CodexBash.

prior_objection_results.prior_objection: Affected files and located sources omit required renderer paths.
evidence: Terminal paths are covered: CodexBashView.tsx, ToolFullView.tsx, SidebarBashView.tsx, CommandView.tsx, CodeView.tsx, and toolCommand.ts.
Patch/diff paths are covered through views/_all.tsx, ToolFullView.tsx, CodeView.tsx, and specialized patch/diff references.
Plan/update paths are covered through plan candidate globs, knownTools.tsx, and generic detail paths.
Dynamic/MCP/resource and fallback paths are covered through ToolView.tsx, ToolFullView.tsx, SidebarGenericView.tsx, SidebarContentRenderer.tsx, and knownTools.tsx.
Image/attachment paths are covered through image candidate globs, ToolFullView.tsx, and sidebar renderer paths.
Markdown/rich paths are covered through MarkdownView/LatexRenderer/markdown candidate globs plus MessageView.tsx.
Multi-tool sequences are covered through reducer child-message handling, ToolView.tsx, ToolFullView.tsx, and sidebar renderers.
prior_objection_results.residual_note: Markdown, image, and plan exact filenames are not proven line locations; however the corrected context explicitly labels them candidate paths requiring dev read-before-edit, which is sufficient for BA handoff.
